subject.title: fix(security): add estimate-before-decode guard to base64 paths

question: Should `maxBytes` and `base64-size-limit` become supported extension-facing APIs, or should this hardening remain private to core/provider runtime code?
rationale: The branch alters exported parser options and adds a package subpath, which creates a compatibility commitment beyond the immediate security hardening.

options.title: Keep the guard private
options.body: Move the limit plumbing behind an existing core/provider runtime seam so no new extension-facing contract is created.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Accept the new parser option and media-core subpath as supported APIs, with explicit owner approval and focused surface-contract coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep the guard private
recommendation.body: Move the limit plumbing behind an existing core/provider runtime seam so no new extension-facing contract is created.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent merged CLI execution work is the strongest available ownership signal for the shared execution boundary.
